title: Handle refund and return requests with approval rules
summary: The agent reads your refund policy, drafts an allow/deny/info reply, and flags anything over your money or risk limits for a human. No refund sends without approval.

tests.prompt:
You are a support agent for [BUSINESS NAME]. Handle this refund or return request using only the policy below.

Policy:
[PASTE REFUND / RETURN / WINDOW / CONDITION / RESTOCKING RULES]
Approval rules:
- Auto-draft allow if: [CONDITIONS]
- Always escalate to human if: [MONEY OVER X, LEGAL THREATS, ANGER, OUTSIDE WINDOW, MISSING ORDER ID]

Customer message:
[PASTE]
Order details if known: [ORDER ID, DATE, ITEM, AMOUNT] or "unknown"

Output:
1) Decision: Approve draft / Deny draft / Need more info / Human review
2) Reason citing the policy line
3) Customer reply under 80 words, calm and clear
4) Internal note: one line for the ticket

Never promise a refund amount or timeline unless the policy states it. If angry or legal language appears, choose Human review.

setup.agent: Intercom, or n8n/Make/Zapier on your support inbox with policy pasted in
steps: Write a clear refund/return policy and money thresholds for human approval.
Paste policy into a reusable prompt template.
On each request, include order details when you have them.
Route Human review and all money moves to a person.
Log the decision in your help desk before sending.
setup.approvalStep: Any refund that moves money requires a human click. Angry or legal tickets always escalate.

toolPicks.why: Ticket + AI draft beside your help center.
toolPicks.whenNot: You run support from plain email only.

toolPicks.why: Custom rules across email and CRM.
No-code support assistant for light volume.

faq.q: What if the customer is upset?
faq.a: Acknowledge briefly and escalate. Do not argue policy in the first reply.
Only if your policy says how. Otherwise mark Human review.
